stemMd: A train 150 m long passes a stationary observer in 10 seconds at constant speed. What is its speed?
explanationMd: To pass a point completely, the train moves one train length. Speed is therefore 150 m divided by 10 s, giving 15 m s⁻¹. No platform length is involved because the observer is stationary at a point.

distractorRationale.c: This multiplies length by time rather than dividing.
distractorRationale.b: This repeats the time as a speed.
distractorRationale.a: Subtracting seconds from metres is invalid.
